# Fortium Group — llms.txt
# https://llmstxt.org — site summary for LLM and Generative Search agents.

> Fortium Group is a direct-hire recruiting agency specializing in Cyber Security and AI Security talent placement. Founded by Punit Dwivedi, an industry veteran with 15+ years of pure Cyber Security domain experience. Tagline: "Gems, not just resumes."

## What Fortium does
- **Direct-hire / permanent placement** recruiting for Cyber Security and AI Security roles.
- **Three engagement models**: Direct-Hire (contingency), Retained Search, Embedded Recruiter.
- **Vetting** is performed by active CISOs and principal security engineers, not generalist HR sourcers.

## Definitions
- **Most Placeable Candidate (MPC)** — A pre-vetted Cyber or AI Security professional whose technical depth, leadership signal, comp expectations, and culture fit have been independently validated by an active industry practitioner.
- **5-stage vetting protocol** — (1) intake calibration, (2) practitioner sourcing, (3) expert technical screen, (4) cultural & comp calibration, (5) reference verification with security peers.

## Practice areas
- Cyber Security: CISO, VP of Security, Security Architect, Detection & Response, AppSec, Cloud Security, IAM, GRC, SOC, IR, Zero Trust Architect, OT/ICS, DevSecOps.
- AI Security: LLM Security Engineer, AI Red Teamer, ML Threat Researcher, AI Governance Lead, Adversarial ML, Model Supply-Chain Security, AI Trust & Safety, Prompt Injection Analyst, Responsible AI Lead, ML SecOps, Model Privacy Engineer.

## Key facts
- 15+ years of pure cyber security domain experience (founder).
- 7-day average first shortlist; 21-day average time-to-offer.
- 90-day replacement guarantee on all direct-hire placements.
- 94% offer acceptance rate (internal placeholder, pending audit).
